top._headline: Incumbent Newpark must defend Saskatchewan Bakken before August 10 lockout
top._insight: Newpark holds the last two consecutive Surge Energy Saskatchewan Bakken contracts, giving them unmatched incumbent leverage, established mud-plant logistics, and a trusted relationship with the operator's drilling team — advantages that are extremely difficult for competitors to overcome in a compressed 10-14 day award window.
